consensus_strengths: The paper defines a concrete conditional decision problem: select or abstain among fixed candidates under subgroup-mixture turnover.
The snapshot clearly distinguishes exact finite-sample bounds from normal/CLT diagnostics and confines M3.5 to a width-surrogate diagnostic.
The continuous-simplex simultaneity argument is promising conditional on valid pair/group bounds and a nonnegative paired certificate.
Manuscript source, PDF, template assets, anonymity, and deterministic build are reproducible from the frozen package.
consensus_weaknesses: The paired certificate omits the self-comparator, so its stated value can be negative although regret is nonnegative; Theorem 1 is false as written.
The adaptive-reveal confidence-sequence claim lacks a defined sampling filtration, low-count behavior, and a valid proof for the stated process.
Universal paired-bound tightness and language treating dependent held-out settlement as nominal certificate coverage are unsupported.

Central numerical results are declared snapshot artifacts but result files, verifiers, configurations, split manifests, and a canonical root-hash procedure are absent or inconsistent in the review snapshot.
Three/five-seed means lack auditable seed-level uncertainty; related-work positioning lacks direct source-verified neighboring selective model-selection/abstention comparisons.
Presentation has dispersed method/status labels, interrupted layout, terse table headers, duplicate proof-ending markers, and a typo.

material_disagreements.topic: Whether a natural temporal/geographic experiment is required for the next revision
positions: The experimental reviewer treats executed E11 as necessary for a real-deployment claim.
The manuscript explicitly states natural-shift validation is unexecuted and limits current evidence to constructed mixture shifts.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Do not require E11 to repair the conditional theorem/scoped paper. Narrow abstract/introduction if needed; execute E11 only to retain or broaden a natural-deployment claim.

material_disagreements.topic: Evidence ceiling under the frozen package
positions: The reproducibility reviewer assigns ceiling 4 because headline artifacts cannot be traced.
Other reviewers assign ceiling 6 after theory/presentation repairs, treating reported artifacts as provisional.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Use 4 as present ceiling: the snapshot cannot audit decision-driving numbers; corrected theorem and replayable artifact package could support reconsideration at 6.

material_disagreements.topic: How to address the adaptive certificate
positions: The technical reviewer requests a complete confidence-sequence theorem and validation.
The paper can remove the adaptive finite-sample contribution and retain static allocation results with narrowed claims.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Choose the smaller truthful revision: remove adaptive guarantee, empirical conclusion, and contribution unless a complete process-specific proof and implementation audit are supplied.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: E11 is decision-relevant only for a natural deployment claim. The snapshot explicitly limits evidence to constructed mixture shifts, so E11 is optional for broadened scope rather than mandatory theorem repair.

prioritized_actions.description: Define the paired regret certificate with max{0,max_{j not equal to i}...} or an explicit self-comparator, repair Theorem 1/proof, and audit reported values/decisions. Remove adaptive CS contribution/results unless observable subgroup information, sampling model, filtration, low-count bounds, and proof are supplied.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: The repaired proof handles a strictly dominant two-model counterexample, every reported certificate is nonnegative, and no retained adaptive claim exceeds evidence.

prioritized_actions.description: Replace universal strict-tighter language with conditional paired-cancellation/certificate-price language; relabel 1.000 as dependent held-out estimated-regret settlement checks; state current evidence is constructed label-prior turnover and M3.5 descriptive only.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: No abstract, theorem, table, caption, or conclusion claims universal paired dominance, true regret observation, nominal experimental coverage, or natural-shift validation absent E11.

prioritized_actions.description: Release reviewer-safe immutable artifacts with raw per-seed losses/predictions, result files, verifiers, configs, commands, seeds, split/preprocessing hashes, environment, logs, and canonical snapshot-hash verifier. Reconcile stale hashes/inventory with delivered archive.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A clean environment using only release regenerates headline tables/figures, resolves paths, and distinguishes artifact replay from end-to-end replay.

prioritized_actions.description: After A03, report seed/split-level paired contrasts, intervals, effect sizes, and test-set uncertainty; treat mixture-grid rows sharing a split as correlated. Narrow findings if replication units are inconclusive.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: All directional comparisons state independent unit/uncertainty and no correlated mixture count is an independent coverage estimate.

prioritized_actions.description: Add primary-source comparisons to finite-sample selective model selection, ranking, abstention, and shift-aware decision certification; contrast outputs, assumptions, data-dependent selection, continuous-mixture scope, regret, and abstention. Narrow if overlap is found.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Each novelty statement maps to verified source and precise non-overlapping distinction, without unsupported priority.

prioritized_actions.description: Only if pursuing a real-deployment claim, complete E11 preregistration and execute source-only FIT/CAL and natural target evaluation, retaining all blocks and reporting conditional-loss uncertainty, exact gate, abstention, and fallback sensitivity.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Executed registry/hashes/isolation/target classifications support only predeclared interpretation.

prioritized_actions.description: Add early taxonomy; reflow late table; define table abbreviations; remove duplicate QED markers and correct typo.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Rendered nine-page main text has contiguous sections, self-contained tables, one QED per proof, and early exact/asymptotic/surrogate taxonomy.

must_resolve_before_accept: Repair self-comparator defect and audit all affected values/decisions.
Establish valid adaptive theorem or remove finite-sample adaptive claim/conclusion.
Narrow universal pairing, held-out coverage, and deployment language.
Provide reproducible empirical artifact package and reconcile provenance/hash assertions.
Add uncertainty-aware seed/split analysis or mark frontier/allocation exploratory.
Establish direct source-verified novelty positioning or narrow contribution claims.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Do not retain the defective theorem with only a limitation sentence.
Do not relabel dependent held-out settlement as certificate coverage or treat 4200 correlated rows independently.
Do not use unexecuted E11, build determinism, or prose descriptions as substitutes for empirical artifacts.
Do not present normal/CLT, M3.5, or expanded citations as finite-sample/deployment evidence without proof/source/experiment.
decision_rationale: The paper is a potentially useful conditional ranking-and-abstention formulation with clean exact/asymptotic/surrogate boundaries and reproducible manuscript build. But the central paired theorem is false as stated, adaptive guarantee unestablished, and decision-driving numerical evidence not reproducible from the frozen submission. These are substantive soundness/provenance failures supporting 4 rather than 2 because the static construction appears repairable. The smallest next revision corrects/removes unsound formal claims, narrows empirical wording, and makes existing evidence auditable; natural-shift execution is optional for broadened scope.
